title.narrative: Equality at the Grassroots - Empowering marginalized Groups to effectively participate in Public Finance Management and decision-making
Equality at the Grassroots - Empowering marginalized Groups to effectively participate in Public Finance Management and decision-making

description.narrative:
TI-Kenya received support from the Embassy of Finland for the 2020-2022 and 2023-2024 period to enhance the participation of marginalized groups in public finance management and decision-making processes in Kisumu, Siaya, Kakamega and Bungoma Counties through the "Usawa Mashinani" project. Despite the progressive successes achieved during the project's implementation, notable gaps remain evident towards the realization of democratic and accountable governance processes. While TI-Kenya and other actors have been engaging county governments over the years on matters good governance, transparency and accountability, there is need for scaling up these engagements through advocating for better citizen involvement and participation, access to information and implementation of more progressive laws and policies. Additionally, engagements around social behavior change, ethical values and culture around corruption are critical towards addressing corruption and achieving democratic and accountable governance in the current Kenyan context. The project will target women, youth, and people with disabilities (PWDs) in 3 counties (Kakamega, Kisumu & Siaya) due to their historically low participation in governance and decision-making processes and was in line with the UN 2030 Agenda seeking to leave no one behind. The project's goal is to enhance transparent governance and decision-making processes in Kakamega, Siaya and Kisumu Counties
The projects objectives include: (a) To strengthen the capacity of marginalized groups to address corruption and demand accountability from public institutions and officers. (b) To strengthen accountability systems and mechanisms at the County level . (c) To improve access to justice for marginalized groups at the County level.
